items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room, like-for-like replacement
items.rationale: Overvoltage caused by lightning is covered (2.3.3). The unit is about 7 m from the hob, so the 5 m climate-equipment exclusion in 2.3.10(c) does not apply. It is described as a fixed, permanently wired unit, so it is a like-for-like replacement under 7.1.9(a); the residual doubt is whether a floor-standing unit counts as firmly connected (4.2.3(a)).

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen, wall-mounted near hob
items.rationale: The unit is a couple of metres from the hob, inside the 5 m distance. Under 2.3.10(c) it is conclusively excluded for overvoltage damage, and no kitchen climate endorsement is on the schedule.

Labour to remove, fit, connect and commission a covered replacement is part of the repair cost (7.1.9(c)). It follows the principal item under 7.1.11, so it stands or falls with line 1; earlier cases never paid this line type.
This is an ancillary charge to the excluded kitchen unit, so it falls with it under 7.1.11 and 2.3.10(c).
The old stand was scorched and could not be reused, so an equivalent support is covered under 7.1.9(b). It is covered only if the living-room unit itself is.
Freight is shared between the covered living-room unit and the excluded kitchen unit. Under 7.1.11 only the covered share is paid, apportioned by value at roughly half of a modest freight charge.
